questions.explanation: For cylinder in sphere, V=πr^2 h with r^2=R^2-(h/2)^2; optimum h=2R/√3=10/√3≈5.7735. The tempting 5 or 10 are not optimum.

questions.subject: ALGEBRA_II
questions.learningObjective: Find local min value of quartic
questions.stem: A cartographer's projection: f(x)=x^4-4x^2; first find critical points, then local min value.
questions.explanation: f'=4x^3-8x=4x(x^2-2); critical 0,±√2. f(±√2)=4-8=-4 (min), f(0)=0 (max). Local min value -4. The tempting values use wrong critical points.
